psk_secret.description: Shared secret for PSK authentication. Required if PSK is enabled.

local_ip.description: Local IP address for the IKE peer.

peer_ip.description: Remote peer IP address for the IKE connection.

local_cert_path.description: Path to the local IKE certificate (PEM format).

local_key_path.description: Path to the local IKE private key (optional if embedded in cert).

ca_cert_path.description: Path to the CA certificate used to verify peer certificates.

ikev2_dpd_enabled.description: Enable Dead Peer Detection (DPD) to detect failed peers.

dpd_maxfail.description: Number of failed DPD probes before the peer is declared dead.

ikev2_debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output (use only when troubleshooting).

peers.description: List of IKEv2 peers (site-to-site or client endpoints).
